about: Test policies checked on each school's own admissions page. College Scorecard's test policy comes from federal reporting that lags behind schools' announcements, so a school listed here uses this instead. Add a school only with an official source.

source.title: Yale Undergraduate Admissions: standardized testing requirements

university-of-pennsylvania.note: Applicants who haven't taken the SAT or ACT and face hardship can ask for a waiver.

stanford-university.note: Required beginning with students who applied in fall 2025.

source.title: Stanford Report: Stanford to resume standardized test requirement (June 2024)

dartmouth-college.note: Required of applicants from U.S. high schools; students from high schools abroad have other options.

source.title: Dartmouth: FAQ on standardized testing reactivation
Johns Hopkins Undergraduate Admissions: standardized testing

california-institute-of-technology.note: Required beginning with applicants for fall 2025.

carnegie-mellon-university.note: Required for every college except the College of Fine Arts, which is test-optional.

university-of-north-carolina-at-chapel-h.note: Not required with a weighted GPA of 2.8 or higher. Below that, an ACT of 17 or higher or an SAT of 930 or higher is required.

source.title: Duke Undergraduate Admissions: resources and FAQs

texas-a-and-m-university-college-station.note: Applicants for spring and fall 2027 aren't affected by a proposed change that would require scores starting in 2028.
